data.one_liner: Extension‑based fluent assertions for Dart unit tests, wrapping package:test matchers.
data.what_it_does: Provides a rich set of extension methods to write readable, chainable assertions in Dart and Flutter tests. It covers equality, nullability, collections, strings, numbers, maps, and exception handling, all mapping to the standard test matcher API.
use_when: You want more expressive, readable test assertions without writing matcher code
You need a comprehensive assertion library covering many data types
You prefer chaining style assertions in unit or widget tests
avoid_when: You have strict constraints on package size or want zero dependencies beyond test
You need custom matcher logic not covered by the provided extensions
strengths: Chains naturally for readable test code
weaknesses: Adds a dev_dependency layer, may duplicate functionality of existing test matchers
Limited to test environment, not for production code
